ios.desc:
Ramble. Capture thoughts. Send anywhere.

Go for a walk. Put your phone in your pocket.
Start a Ramble.
Talk out loud. Get your thoughts out.
Get an accurate transcript. 
Pipe it _anywhere_ via webhook.

Ramble is an onramp into your systems. 

- Best-in-class transcription -
Pick the speech-to-text model that fits your voice:
- Apple Speech on-device
- Groq Whisper v3 Turbo
- Groq Whisper Large v3
- Deepgram Nova-3
- OpenAI GPT-4o Transcribe
- New cloud models added as they ship

- Your voice triggers anything -
Every transcript can automatically POST to any HTTPS endpoint. Connect Ramble to:
- AI agents - ramble your thoughts, let AI sort them out
- Zapier & Make - plug into any automation platform with a single webhook
- Notion & Airtable - journaling, meeting notes, field logs, straight into your database
- Your own backend - signed requests, automatic retries, full API docs

- A great Apple Watch App -
Record on your wrist, no connection required. Talk, and the recording syncs to your phone for transcription. Built for getting off your screen, not staring at it.

- Private by design -
No accounts. No login. No data on our servers. Audio and transcriptions stay on your device unless you send them somewhere. Fully open source - read the code.

- Reliable by design -
Offline-first. Persistent queues. Clear status at all times. Record a thought on a hike, the transcript is there when you get home.

- Pricing -
The app is free. Apple Speech and webhook delivery are free forever. Cloud transcription models are available via an optional $2.99/month subscription.

Not another note app. Not another AI assistant. A simple tool that captures your voice and sends it wherever you want.

Privacy Policy: https://goodloop.dev/ramble/privacy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://goodloop.dev/ramble/terms

quotes.text:
Hi HN, I'm JP

I wanted to automate my voice notes - pocket the phone (or watch), walk and talk, then send the transcript to my agent for processing.
So I built Ramble for myself.

It's a simple app. An on-ramp into your systems.
Free. Open source. No accounts.

Why a new app?
1) Apple Voice Memos are great, but no way to automate the result. You're also stuck with Apple's transcription (it got slightly better in iOS26 but still not the best)
2) Voice transcription in Claude / ChatGPT / messaging apps is built for short back-and-forth chat, not capturing a 10-minute walking ramble. They also don't let you record offline on Apple Watch.
3) I wanted a minimal distraction-free app to record thoughts and trust they'll be delivered. Nothing more.

I've been using Ramble on my phone & watch for months. Talk-to-think became a regular habit and I started getting real value from it. I highly recommend long-form talking to voice notes as a way to process your thoughts, regardless!

Some technical notes:

Native iPhone + Apple Watch, SwiftUI, no third-party deps. App is < 2MB.

Recordings and transcripts stored locally on device. Watch recordings work offline and sync to the phone when in range.

Default transcription is Apple's on-device SFSpeechRecognizer (free, offline). Cloud models (Groq, Deepgram, OpenAI, etc) are optional and route through a stateless Cloudflare Worker that forwards audio and returns text. Nothing persisted server-side. It's all in the repo if you want to …
